notes: Spine: skin-seal need -> Si-HA nanorod hypothesis -> HA-on-Ti base + Si-for-P modification -> hydrothermal growth -> nanorod shape (topography branch) and Si incorporation -> SiO4 on PO4 sites -> lattice distortion -> more Ca + Si release (ion branch); topography + Si jointly raise 1-d adhesion (MEC n19); ions -> fibrogenic genes (MEC n18, argued) -> collagen; adhesion + collagen jointly -> in-vivo skin seal (F9) -> conclusion. Audits: o12 ~1/3 of Si 2p area is non-lattice silicate (qualifies n10); o15 (002) shift vs c-value inconsistency and delta-a at error level (qualifies n11); o22 3-d gene data do not follow the stated order (qualifies n16). Packet: F2 tagged C3_caption_swap but image matches its caption; F6b crop OCR cue 'micrograph' is a misread axis label on a bar chart (citation dropped). Not in graph: F3a/F3e TEM rod widths (~60 and ~95 nm vs text 70 nm), FWHM broadening claim (not resolvable), F7 3-d HA cell count claim (not evident).
